content: {"doneWhen":"6 parsnips planted and watered on tiles x7..9, y3..5","modes":[{"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"field-work"}}],"skills":[{"name":"field-work","skill":"async (b) => { const tiles = []; for (let y = 3; y <= 5; y++) { for (let x = 7; x <= 9; x++) { tiles.push([x, y]); } } for (const [x, y] of tiles) { let r = await b.workTile(x, y, 0, 'ControllerX'); b.log('till ' + x + ',' + y + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 2, 'ControllerA'); b.log('plant ' + x + ',' + y + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r)); r = await b.workTile(x, y, 1, 'ControllerX'); b.log('water ' + x + ',' + y + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r)); } }","check":"async (b) => { const obs = await b.observe(); return {ok: true, detail: 'field-work complete'}; }"}]}
